headline: Tower floods at +25% - needs high-capacity trays
summary: Today PV-1767 is already at 99.6% of flood (PV1767-base). At 25% more feed the existing conventional 4-pass trays flood at 105.9% / 124.6% of limit (PV1767-125-test). Retraying to high-capacity trays with factor 1.65 brings flood to 83.4% / 97.9% and capacity to 1.275× (PV1767-proposal-1.65), passing every check.

assumptions: Feed composition and condition fixed at April 2015 pre-project basis: T -9.5C, P 25.5 bar, 92 t/h, mole fractions N2 0.000465, Methane 0.000897, Ethylene 0.641, Ethane 0.35544, Propylene 0.001459, Isobutane 0.000703; shift to 69 wt% ethylene not separately modelled - 1.25× total feed is conservative for +25% ethylene product.

Tower model per P&ID note: 156 stages (154 trays + condenser + reboiler), feed stage 118 (37 trays from bottom), P_top 22.94 bar, dP 1.703 bar, partial condenser, DWSIM Fair flooding with tray spacing 0.508 m.
Pasteurization chimney section lumped as liquid distillate (ETHYLENE product), side reboiler folded into main reboiler duty; Murphree efficiency 0.78 applied to all trays.
Product specs fixed by model: distillate = polymer-grade ETHYLENE stream, bottoms rate 324.4 mol/s and reflux ratio 6.08 at 1.0× scaled with throughput; VENT vapour 38.8 mol/s light-ends purge.
No condenser/reboiler, pump, compressor or heat-integration limits defined in supplied limits - only Fair flood fraction vs 0.85 checked.
High-capacity tray factor 1.65 is vendor hydraulic rating at same diameter and spacing; actual rating to be confirmed by tray vendor hydraulic calculation and pressure-drop check.

headline: Retray to high-capacity trays 1.85× passes envelope
summary: PV-1767 4.88 m ID is flood limited. At 25 % more feed the existing conventional 4-pass trays flood at 107.9% of limit at 1.375× (PV1767-1.65-plus10). Retraying to high-capacity trays with rated factor 1.85 lowers flood to 74.4% at 1.25× (test-1.85-at-target) and 81.8% at 1.375× feed +10% worst case (PV1767-1.85-plus10), and to 76.7% with the richer 69 wt% feed (PV1767-newfeed-69pct-1.80-plus10), all <85% limit, passing every check at polymer-grade purity.

changes.basis: Hydraulic rating to pass 1.375× envelope worst case flood 0.818 <0.85; 1.80× is minimum 0.841, 1.85× adds margin for assumed 0.78 efficiency – vendor high-capacity 4-pass tray (e.g. Sulzer ULTRA-FLO / Koch-Glitsch SuperFrac) rated 1.8-1.9× conventional

proposals.why: At target +25% ethylene the 16 ft, 154-tray column is at 99.6% flood today; at feed +10% envelope top it floods at 107.9% with 1.65× trays. 1.85× rating gives 87.5% at 1.25× and 96.2% at 1.375× even on the lean old feed (rich 69 wt% feed is lower flood). No process-side pressure or purity change needed – duties scale proportionally and purity stays 99.99% ethane-free in model.

Propose physical changes that fix each failed check (equipment, ratings with a real item behind them, operating settings within documented limits), cheapest first. Return the FULL design as proposals: every earlier verified change you keep plus the new ones, so the design answer stands on its own. Do not edit a limit to pass a check.
